responsibility: Implements the privacy reachability analysis over Rust HIR vis-items. The ReachabilityVisitor derives initial reachability from item visibility, records reachable DefIds in PrivacyContext, propagates reachability into generic trait bounds and selected nested members such as struct public fields and enum variants, and therefore computes the privacy subsystem’s notion of which exported or transitively exposed definitions are externally reachable.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for reachability analysis: unlike rust-reachability.h, it contains the logic that computes and propagates ReachLevel across modules, generics, enum variants, and selected fields by updating PrivacyContext during HIR visitation.
